# The compiler's mentions of the prelude's Option, Some and None
# (TestLoweringNamesNoPreludeUnion; ADT-NOPRIV, design A, approved
# 2026-11-20). A line is
# `dir/file.go:function<TAB>count<TAB>verdict<TAB>unit<TAB>reason`:
# count is the function's string literals "Option", "Some", "None" or
# "Timeout", and the field names Value, In and Signal a field accessor
# reads (TestLoweringNamesNoPreludeUnion's preludeFieldNames);
# verdict is `by name` (a decision keyed on the name), `language` (the
# compiler builds the type there) or `debt` (another inventory holds the
# row as debt); unit is the ADT-NOPRIV unit that removes it. The list only
# shrinks, and the rule is done when it is empty. Seeded from the
# findings' census (§1): a site of the census with no literal of its own
# (extern.go's adapters, provider.go, nicheAdmitted, gocall.go's callers,
# moveout.go) reaches the name through the helper that holds the row.
check/cells.go:optionParams	2	by name	SHAPE-BOUNDARY	Option and Some, as go.Ref, may hold a confined Go value (their code sends nothing to a task): by the two-variant shape
check/decl.go:checker.resolveNamed	2	by name	GEN9-GENERAL	Option/Some admit an unmarked resource by name (MODES-5 cbd123139); removed by GEN9-GENERAL (MODES): a rule read from the declaration, so a user generic union admits it too
check/entry.go:checker.machineAfterShape	2	language	ADT-LANG	a machine's After is func(S) Option[Timeout[…]]: read the prelude Machine record's declared field type (Option and Timeout)
check/entry.go:checker.machineAfterEvery	1	language	ADT-LANG	a machine's After (every) is func(S) Option[…]: read the declared field type
check/entry.go:IsEvery	2	by name	ADT-LANG	an Every timer (FKG1) is known by its field names In and Signal: read it from the declared After field
check/entry.go:EveryClock	1	by name	ADT-LANG	an Every timer's Signal field read by name
check/exit.go:checker.machineExitRow	1	language	ADT-LANG	a machine's Exit is func(S) Option[func()]: read the declared field type
check/extern.go:optionElem	1	by name	SHAPE-BOUNDARY	a Go result (T, bool), a nilable pointer or (…, error) adapts to Option: any union of the two-variant shape (q271)
check/goany.go:checker.goAnyAs	1	language	ADT-LANG	the any-cast returns Option[T]: the type go.As's prelude declaration names
check/goerror.go:checker.goErrorCall	1	language	ADT-LANG	go.As[T] returns Option[T]: the type its prelude declaration names
